Database.//: SqlServer is the default everywhere, including Development, so a fresh clone of this repository runs against SQL Server exactly as it always has. Do NOT commit a different value here: this file is tracked, so changing it would switch the database for everyone who pulls.
Database.//local: To use a persistent local file instead, create appsettings.Local.json (gitignored) containing { "Database": { "Provider": "Sqlite" } }, or set Database__Provider=Sqlite in the environment. Both override this file without being committed.

ConnectionStrings.//: Only read when Database:Provider is Sqlite. Ignored on SQL Server, which uses DefaultConnection from appsettings.json.
